name: Munch Max
ingredients: Sugar, Refined Wheat flour (Maida), Hydrogenated vegetable fat, Fractionated vegetable fat. Milk solids, Cocoa solids (4%), Emulsifier (Soya lecithin), Raising agent (500(i)), Yeast, lodised salt. Flour-treatment agent (516), Artificial (Vanilla) and Nature-Identical flavouring substances. Contains Wheat, Sesame, Milk and Soy.
